features.title: Reality bender
features.text: Witchwarpers draw magic from alternate realities. Their paradox determines whether they cast arcane or occult spells and how their quantum field changes the battlefield.

features.title: Quantum field
features.text: Keep this zone active to use warp focus spells. Casting one on your turn also sustains the field. Each spell sets its own targets and area.
